integrity: The definitions, symbolic proof, complete formula and independently replayable finite-field checker are supplied. A same-model scientific review was performed; external independent audit was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite ordinal sums of antichains with at least two elements per level; lower Alexandrov topology. Field persistence barcodes and torsion-free integral stage homology. title: Complete rooted furtherness barcodes and reconstruction of finite weak orders
